exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix claim-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: claim-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card create --priority 1 'Waiting handoff'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-waiting.txt
exec card create 'Ready pool work'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-ready.txt
exec card --actor alice --json claim claim-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/claimed.json

! exec card --actor bob release claim-1
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/not-owner.txt
! exec card --actor alice release --waiting '' claim-1
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/waiting-reason-required.txt
exec card show claim-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/show-claimed.txt

exec card --actor alice --json release --waiting 'Awaiting root review' claim-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/waiting.json
exec card --json ready
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/ready-pool.jsonl
exec card --actor pool claim
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/pool-claim.txt

exec card --actor root --json claim claim-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/direct-claim.json
exec card --actor root --json release claim-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/released.json
